items.title: Forget SPY: Invesco’s Fund Gives the Smallest S&P 500 Company the Same Say as the Largest
items.summary: SPY hands most of your money to a handful of giants, but one rival fund treats the smallest S&P 500 company as an equal to the largest. The tradeoff is stranger than it sounds, and the recent returns reveal a tension every index investor should weigh.
